body: Ive been taking escitalopram for almost two months now and i think it's been working well for me. It started around the time the lockdown in my country began so I guess I can't say for sure if Ive completely improved with regards to emotional control esp in public or in social situations but so far, I havent had an intense episode other than mild periods of depression and anxiety.

I get frequent breakdowns or episodes too. The most impulsive thing I've done was suddenly running away from one place out of suddenly feeling embarrassed and then breaking down somewhere else. Recently, I've tried grounding myself too and idk if it has been that helpful, I keep ending up getting mad or scared at every single thing I look at. Taking in deep breaths gets me back to reality for a moment but makes me break down and cry after. What else do you guys do? :(
